description: Enforcement for the punch report workflow. Every wiring uses the polyglot shell-form pattern proven in field testing: the .ps1 half runs on Windows hosts (where hooks execute in Cowork), the .sh half on POSIX surfaces, each no-ops on the other's platform, and the trailing `exit 0` is valid in every shell Claude Code routes to. Three of the four are context-only and can never block. The fourth is a deliberately narrow deny on converting a punch report to PDF with LibreOffice, which is the one mistake here that has already shipped to a reviewer. Each hook has its own EPLUS_NO_* escape hatch. Note that PostToolUseFailure is deliberately NOT wired here: the error-reporting plugin already owns that event, and a second wiring produces a duplicate nudge for the same failure.
